{"body":"### Finite invalid-sampling reporting at `66952415`

Finite native estimates that sample outside the fixed detector ROI now retain all field-error diagnostics, report `sampling_status=OUTSIDE_FIXED_ROI`, emit null candidate image metrics and exit 1. Malformed/nonfinite inputs retain input-error exit 2. Fixed ROI, truth, thresholds and historical reports are preserved.

Local macOS validation: diagnostics 11/11, existing verdict 8/8, runner 8/8 and downstream #269 controls 10/10 PASS. All 32 valid-report comparisons retain their metrics; 16 archived STAR replays emit reports, including all three estimates that previously aborted. The old-code negative control rejects the original behavior. [Report contract](https://github.com/KingAlejandro/MotionCorr-standalone/blob/6695241523d7285d4f0480abf1c4a2c6423c3617/docs/motion_diagnostics_v2.md). [Current-head Linux CI](https://github.com/KingAlejandro/MotionCorr-standalone/actions/runs/39764363890) **PASS**: CPU CTest 74/74, all 11 diagnostic controls, and CUDA compile-only. This replays retained estimates; no new native application execution, GPU campaign or full #272 campaign is claimed.

---

The historical local fixture renders `B(p-M(p))` but declares `-M(q)` as its inverse correction. Negation is exact for translation, not general spatial motion. This PR adds a separate versioned diagnostic family with analytic affine inverses and local round-trip controls; it preserves every historical fixture, result and threshold.

Adds eight 128×96×5 cases: zero, asymmetric signed integer/fractional translation, affine global/local motion, pedestal/contrast, noise, flat and repeated patterns. Continuous analytic synthesis uses no production warp. The checker evaluates fixed-gauge fields in px/Å (RMS/P95/max), independent target-signal accuracy and bilinear sampling floors on a fixed truth-defined ROI. Optional published non-DW sums are compared separately. Unidentifiable cases, characterization failures and untested application consistency stay explicit; no aggregate scientific PASS.

[Design, commands, external-data reuse decision and limitations](docs/motion_diagnostics_v2.md). Xmipp's published phantom generator is considered for an optional offline comparison; no mandatory data download or copied third-party code. Small generation receipts and explicitly labeled truth-fed control reports are included, not movies.

Validation on main base `3691374061f782bc84531fd1c79d017ddcb5a7c2`, NumPy 2.3.5, one BLAS thread:
- `python3 tools/test_motion_diagnostics.py -v`: 8/8, including inverse/sign/axis/units/frame/local-field mutants, a hand-authored STAR, corrupt inputs and CLI exits.
- Existing verdict controls: 8/8; existing runner controls: 8/8.
- Regeneration byte-identical within this environment; generated artifacts 9.9 MB. CI runs the new controls.
- Python compilation and diff whitespace checks pass.

Native MotionCorr execution on the **new eight-case family**, CUDA execution, performance and scientific outcomes remain **not run**. This saved environment lacks a built binary, FFTW development headers and CUDA tools; the GitHub runner subsequently built and tested the CPU application as detailed below. Signal thresholds, nonlinear fields, larger seed populations and full-precision native coefficient evaluation remain follow-ups. Exact-truth control results are not estimator results.

Existing-work check: #63 merged; #79 integrated via #82. Open PRs and all 234 remote branches contained no active PR for this new family. No duplicate of operator repairs #254/#260 or evidence #261. Refs #238, #262, #265, #61. No production changes and no merge requested.

Follow-up documentation records published Xmipp archives, the warped-image smoke case, Parakeet, Roodmus and NoiseFlow with licensing/provenance and explicit offline reuse decisions. No external dataset was downloaded. The new evaluator is a manual offline tool: the existing end-to-end runner does not launch this new family, and external movies still need a validated fixture/coordinate adapter. CI exercises generator/evaluator controls alongside the existing native MotionCorr suite; it does not yet measure native recovery on these eight new cases.

### Review repair and final current-head CI
At `88b34ae06416a3cde233889fe5a0f244b1c16bf4`, the new adapter rejects malformed STAR geometry and incomplete/duplicate/out-of-range frame or coefficient identifiers before legacy parsing. Regression controls require clean input-error exit 2, and signal controls verify zero, truth and wrong-sign candidates take the intended evaluation branches. The legacy reader and production sources remain unchanged.

[Current-head Linux CI](https://github.com/KingAlejandro/MotionCorr-standalone/actions/runs/39574527995) **completed successfully**: CPU build, **74/74 CTest**, historical known-motion/canonical checks, all **8/8 new diagnostics tests**, smoke/failure checks, and CUDA **compile-only**. Historical `km_local_noisy` remains characterization **FAIL** (total RMS 0.6595 Å) despite the historical aggregate passing. No native GPU execution or native recovery on the new family is claimed.
